name: Anthropic Life Sciences Marketplace
description: Official Anthropic marketplace of MCP servers and skills for life sciences tools, installable into Claude Code for research workflows.
longDescription: anthropics/life-sciences is Anthropic's Life Sciences Marketplace for Claude Code: a plugin collection of MCP servers and skills exposing specialized research tools and databases. It accompanies the Claude for Life Sciences launch, which added scientific connectors and drug-discovery-oriented capabilities. The clearest signal that life-science agent tooling is now a first-party ecosystem.
